QR Scavenger Hunt Builder

Type in your stations, get a printable sheet of QR codes and a separate answer key — nothing leaves your browser

1 · Stations
LabelQR content (link or text)Answer key note (optional)TypeCode word
A QR content value that looks like a bare web address (like "example.com/clue") gets "https://" added automatically. Anything that doesn't look like a link is encoded as plain text as-is.
2 · Print Layout
The answer key prints separately, with your notes and the raw QR content — keep it with you, not with the students. Export CSV saves your typed station list (not the print-ready QR content) for your own records. Clue cards post the same station text with no QR code, plus a code word — pair them with the printed Team Answer Sheets in Live Run for a day with no Chromebooks.
Preview

Add at least one station with content to see a preview.

Teams
Each team gets a check-in code (shown next to its name) so it can check itself in below without you hunting through a roster — print the cards so teams can carry or show their code. Answer Sheets print one per team, blank, in that team's own route order — for a day with no devices, pair them with the Build tab's Clue Cards and check them against the Print Answer Key.
